name: Suri
source:
Despite suffering from depression caused by the loss of her family, Suri cares deeply for others and regularly prepares food for the members of the resistance against Beexen’s phantoms.

Little is known about Suri’s past, except that he lost his family during the war against Beexen’s phantoms. By the beginning of The Beexen’s Tale, he is a member of the resistance movement opposing Beexen’s phantoms, serving specifically as a field cook.
